description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton object RepositoryApiAdapter that provides a method to construct a Repository instance using various API clients. It primarily facilitates creating a repository with explicit API client dependencies, enabling easy swapping for testing or different implementations without modifying business logic.

methods.name: fromClients
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Repository object using provided or default API client instances, encapsulating API calls for content, metadata, assets, and likes within anonymous object implementations.
